title: Antisymmetric Matrix Games Have Value
body_html:
Antisymmetric Matrix Games Have Value

Let $B$ be a real square matrix satisfying $B=-B^T$. Then the matrix game $B$ has a value. Equivalently, there exists $x\in\Delta(I)$ such that $$ Bx\le 0. $$

References

  • [MFoGT, Section 2.8, Exercise 10(1)] Laraki, Renault, and Sorin, Mathematical Foundations of Game Theory, references/MechDesign.pdf. Brown-von Neumann theorem for antisymmetric games.
